digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport layer and backend reconciliation
propositions: DC transport is missing 12 methods required by the reconciler core, causing crashes on writing passes or silent degradation when exceptions are swallowed at call sites
The port TicketTransport declares only 6 members but the core actually invokes 21 distinct members, leaving the majority of required functionality absent and undetectable until runtime
Implementing only set_entity_property moves the crash deeper without fixing the capability, as 11 other methods remain absent and will fail on subsequent operations
DC reporter sync re-emits on every pass because _identity_of reads only accountId (which is None on DC) rather than falling back to DC's name field, preventing idempotence
Absence of logging in transport.py means 7 of the 12 missing members fail silently even after implementation, producing false convergence while functionality breaks
The port must be made @runtime_checkable and conformance must be asserted at backend construction time to make missing members fail loudly rather than at unpredictable call sites
